versions.changelog: fix: add _client.live=True so --live actually routes to polymarket-venue for real USDC trades
Fix apply_skill_config AttributeError for new Simmer SDK compatibility

Crypto-Geopolitics Lag Trader skill initial release:

- Detects divergence between Polymarket geopolitical escalation markets and crypto price threshold markets.
- Computes real-time "geo_heat" and "crypto_optimism" scores to identify trading opportunities due to lagged market responses.
- Trades crypto threshold markets when their prices haven't yet reflected sharp geopolitical changes, with automated sizing and safeguards.
- Offers advanced tunables for risk management and control through Simmer UI.
- Defaults to paper trading mode; can be enabled for live execution with explicit flag.
